headline: Kenya's Family Bank Reports 68% Profit Rise to Sh6 Billion After Listing
summary: Family Bank Group posted a 68% surge in nine-month net profit to 6 billion shillings following its listing on the Nairobi Securities Exchange.
why: Family Bank is among Kenya's fast-growing commercial lenders; expanding profitability following public equity listing highlights regional banking sector resilience.

impacts.name: Family Bank Group
impacts.why: Nine-month after-tax earnings jumped 68% year-on-year to 6 billion shillings.
